scope: Isolated reduced PGlite schema contract; not staging/Supabase-stack readiness
concurrency_limit: PGlite serializes its single backend; competing requests tested, real multi-session lock contention requires full PostgreSQL integration.

results.name: Moderation installs against the original and live staging business-status enum without invented values
Synthetic fixtures cover all four queues and every content target
Unauthenticated, merchant and customer cannot list, inspect or decide
Revoked admins immediately lose read and decision access; clients cannot self-grant membership
Anonymous execution, private projection, legacy writes and audit tampering denied
Owner cannot bypass moderation via direct business status update
Search, literal wildcard search, pagination and empty states are correct
Required reasons, readiness failures and unsupported destructive actions rejected
Audit insertion failure rolls back the underlying decision
Competing decisions reject stale state; retries are idempotent and audited once
Business approval is reversible; information requests remain owner-visible
Business rejected to editable draft and safely reopened
Content reports reviewing, resolve, dismiss and reopen preserve reported content
Pickup review hide/restore/dismiss/reopen are reversible and centrally audited
Event reviews use the same reversible manual moderation contract
Signals detect missing data, structured duplicates, spam and activity with manual fallback
Recommendation evaluation is deterministic and makes no data or audit change
Synthetic runtime fails closed for production/staging/hosted configurations
Default demo submissions are complete and use the validated submission RPC
Original review submission/report methods enforce eligibility, bounds and self-report protections
Normal content report payload and RLS require a valid reason, caller identity and open status
Client submission gate fails closed for missing checks, non-owner, non-draft and repeat taps
Server submission rejects each missing requirement without changing the pending fixture
Direct owner submission is blocked; complete owner RPC submission succeeds once
Pending profile, category, hours and photo edits return the business to draft
Guidance explains evidence, conditional action, public effect, alternatives and reversal
Business outcome alerts target active owners, retain public feedback, and exclude private data
Repeated decision and notification-helper retry cannot duplicate the outcome alert
Inbox owners can mark read but cannot rewrite outcomes, delivery state or recipients
Wrong user, expired session and forged quick-action reads fail without mutations
Reversal alerts supersede queued push and old quick actions use current item state
Review hide and restoration alert the review author, never the reporting merchant
Content and event-review outcomes target owners/authors and reveal no allegations
Notification write failure rolls back the decision and its audit
Disabled push preference still creates an immediately readable in-app outcome
Removed ownership blocks inbox access, dispatch and new outcomes atomically
Outbox claim/retry uses one durable row; fake transport contains no private or public reason
Missing owned review makes historical outcome unavailable without item disclosure
Guest proof allows a normal pickup review; moderation is reversible and records no-account notification
Event review with a removed author can still be moderated without inventing a recipient
Absent push activation gate preserves inbox while keeping the legacy dispatcher from claiming outcomes
Anonymized or scrubbed audit history cannot be mistaken for an identical actor retry
Privacy-redacted history cannot replay a substituted marker as a complete decision result
